sanjay: quick heads-up from the devstg bring-up for artemis-7b-qat — short prompts look fine but multi-sentence instructions are getting mangled (weird spaces inserted and occasional <<UNK>> tokens).

sanjay: example output snippet:```
Prompt: "Summarize the following policy in 3 bullets: ..."
Output: "Summ ary:
 • keeps ...
 • res trictions ... <<UNK>>"```

marie: ouch. looks like a tokenizer mismatch to me. which tokenizer + vocab were used when exporting?

sanjay: model was exported with a custom merges file and using hf/rome-tokenizer v2. suspicion: byte-level vs unicode normalization mismatch during export -> split on unicode boundaries. also saw a small loss spike when running the int8 QAT checkpoint (around step 100).

elaine: can you paste the top-5 logits for the broken token indices and the token ids? also run the same prompt against the hosted baseline so we can compare output shape/length.

sanjay: pasted below (top-5 logits) and repro command.

sanjay: ```
# quick repro against devstg
curl -s -X POST https://devstg.api.redwood/model/serve \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"artemis-7b-qat","prompt":"Summarize the following policy in 3 bullets: ...","max_tokens":120}' | jq '.text'
```

giorgio: try forcing tokenizer normalization on decode/encode. e.g. set normalizer to NFKC or enable `replace_unknown=False` depending on tok impl. quick check: does `tok.decode(tok.encode(s)) == s` hold for the failing prompts?

giorgio: tiny unit test to add:```
def test_tokenize_roundtrip(tok, s):
    ids = tok.encode(s)
    assert tok.decode(ids) == s
```

devops-bot: deploy job #4021 finished for artemis-7b-qat on devstg (8 x a100s). all pods report Ready. logs at https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/4021 :white_check_mark:

marie: proposed prioritization: 1) tokenizer alignment check (fast) 2) re-run qat export with original merges + compare logits 3) add 25 instruction-style regression prompts to the onboarding checklist and fail build on mismatch. who wants what?

elaine: I'll take tokenizer alignment + unit tests. will run the 25 prompt harness and post results. planning ~1-2 hours.

sanjay: i'll re-export the quantized checkpoint with original merges and re-run the int8 QAT job, will share loss curve and a diff of decoded outputs (~30m).

marie: perfect. once you both have results, we'll decide if we need to fallback to fp16 baseline for canary traffic. put findings in the onboarding checklist doc and tag #eng-ml. :thumbsup:

sanjay: noted — linking the quick notes here after rerun.

elaine: FYI i added two quick prompts that used to fail in a previous model: short instructions with bullets and multi-sentence prefatory text. if those pass we should be good for a minimal smoke.

marie: thanks team — let's keep the thread focused on tokenization vs quant artifacts. we'll reconvene in this thread with diffs.
